text.en: Clients consistently report marked progress in their dogs after attending puppy foundations, board and train, and day camp sessions. Owners note calmer demeanours, improved leash walking, and positive socialisation around other dogs in everyday situations.

Reviewers praise the trainers and transport handlers in East Falls for their knowledge and thoughtful guidance. Pet owners highlight how instructors tailor exercises to individual canine temperaments and create an encouraging learning atmosphere for families.

Pet owners commend the administrative and training staff for prompt scheduling and attentive follow-up. Reviewers mention receiving thorough answers to behavioural queries, regular check-ins after medical events, and high-quality photo updates from farm outings.

q.en: What training programmes are available at the East Falls facility?

a.en: The centre offers puppy foundation courses, group socialization classes, adult obedience, board-and-train packages, and private behavioural coaching.

q.en: What is the Farm Dog day camp programme?

a.en: Farm Dog is an outdoor adventure day camp providing supervised playtime, trail exploration, creek activities, and structured exercise for enrolled canines.

q.en: Are puppy socialisation sessions offered for young dogs?

a.en: Yes, trainers hold structured puppy socials that allow young puppies to play safely in designated indoor areas while owners learn foundational management skills.

q.en: How do owners schedule classes and daycare services?

a.en: Clients can get in touch through the online contact form or coordinate directly with administrative staff for bookings and evaluation sessions.
